title: Manifest integrity is not executable resource closure
trigger: A delivered runtime entry references a local shader, worker, WASM, schema, model, or other resource that is absent from the delivery or absent from its manifest, while tests still pass by returning before the load or replacing the loader with a mock.

currentReplay.subject: KAOPU_VEHICLE_FUNCTION_REBUILD_R01_PRIVATE.zip version 18
currentReplay.observation: runtime/gpu-experiment/index.mjs fetches ./compute.wgsl, but runtime/gpu-experiment/compute.wgsl is absent and not pinned by CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST.json. The checkpoint builder allowlist omits .wgsl. CPU/fail-closed and CPU/mock suites pass without compiling the packaged shader.

followupReplays.subject: A6_POST4376852_NATIVE_FREEZE_HOST_PREPARATION_R01_20261101.zip
followupReplays.observation: The archive contains a complete relative native snapshot and its untouched manifest verifies 66/66. In a fresh workspace, test-exact and test-negative-ownership passed, but replay-smoke stopped at revision-guard-tests because mkdtempSync hard-codes /workspace/shared/post4376852-guard-* and the parent directory did not exist. Creating only /workspace/shared, without changing package bytes, made all four core replay programs pass.
followupReplays.distinction: This is not a missing geometry/runtime module and does not invalidate the fixed-revision numeric, ownership, or hot-cost evidence. It is an undeclared replay-environment/writable-temp-root dependency.

followupReplays.subject: A6_WHOLE_CPU_INSPECTION_R02.zip version 1
followupReplays.observation: The untouched archive verified 560/560 manifest entries and fresh-replayed two actual CPU frames byte-identically. A verifier-only no-op comment mutation of imported site/cpu-whole/cache-runtime.mjs produced one manifest mismatch, yet RESTORE_DISPLAY.mjs still returned PASS with the same frame hashes because it verifies selected data/cache/output hashes but does not consume MANIFEST.json before importing the executable JS/WASM closure.
followupReplays.distinction: This does not invalidate the display repair or deterministic outputs for the exact untouched package. It identifies a narrower pre-execution runtime identity binding gap: integrity metadata exists but is not wired into the restore gate.

candidateRule.verifierGate: For every in-scope local runtime resource reference, require file existence, manifest hash coverage, and at least one test that loads the delivered bytes. A mock returning substitute bytes cannot establish delivery closure. For a claimed self-contained replay, also require a fresh-extraction run with no author-workspace directories precreated; every required writable/cache/temp root must be declared and either created by the harness or derived from an OS/package-local temporary directory. A bounded partial replay may require an explicit external final-GO only when that prerequisite is declared and bound to the exact archive SHA; the receipt must preserve the allowlist, archive-before/after identity, negative I/O controls, actual runtime scope, and output byte identity, and must not promote an isolated stage to current/default authority. When a replay claims fixed executable runtime identity, validate the complete delivered manifest before any runtime JS module or WASM executes; static ESM imports require a separate preflight wrapper or post-validation dynamic imports. Any imported-byte mismatch must stop before rendering and must not emit a PASS receipt.

minimumFalsifiableTrial.pass: All referenced GPU resources exist and are manifest-pinned; the device test loads the delivered WGSL and reaches real shader compilation on an available adapter.
minimumFalsifiableTrial.fail: Any referenced runtime resource is absent/unpinned, or all green tests bypass/replace its load.

boundaries: Does not reject the mathematical geometry, CPU renderer, or the design of the isolated GPU experiment.
Does not claim WebGPU hardware failure; no actual adapter executed this package.
Does not require global adoption before a second Mother or historical replay validates usefulness.
Offline source triangulation used only for observation is outside this gate unless it becomes a delivered runtime dependency.
An explicitly named, pinned external artifact is not silently missing; it remains a declared prerequisite and cannot support a standalone/self-contained replay claim until materialized.
A hard-coded writable temp root is replay-environment closure, distinct from geometry/runtime module closure; fixing it does not certify numeric results beyond the already tested fixed revision.

A manifest may correctly describe all packaged bytes while the executable restore entry still fails to enforce it; this is a wiring defect in the gate, not proof that the untouched runtime output is wrong.
rollback: Remove this Candidate if a replay shows that the referenced resource is intentionally external and the delivery contract names, pins, and validates that external dependency explicitly.
